content.class.traveller.blurb: 你伴着最后一丝天光登上哈罗隘口，隘口屋是这里到山那边唯一的屋顶。
content.class.traveller.kit.0.name: 手杖
content.class.traveller.name: 旅行者
content.dlg.bet.bet-bar.opt.0.label: 拉一下
content.dlg.bet.bet-bar.text: 好了。门闩上了。把手插进墙里，在牌子下面，就能拉响它。用力拉一下。
content.dlg.bet.bet-dusk.opt.0.label: 那就闩上门
content.dlg.bet.bet-dusk.text: 隘口钟在屋顶上。拉杆在西墙。把手我收在围裙里，不然每个在这儿落脚的孩子都会拉它玩。
content.dlg.bet.bet-hello.opt.0.label: 有地方住吗？
content.dlg.bet.bet-hello.opt.1.label: 黄昏会怎样？
content.dlg.bet.bet-hello.text: 进来吧。看天色，今天你是最后一个上隘口的。
content.dlg.bet.bet-ring.opt.0.label: 拉一下
content.dlg.bet.bet-ring.text: 拉杆在墙里，牌子下面。用力拉一下，钟就响。
content.dlg.bet.bet-room.opt.0.label: 什么钟？
content.dlg.bet.bet-room.opt.1.label: 那就闩门
content.dlg.bet.bet-room.text: 总有地方。这屋子是给天黑前到的人住的。天黑后，门闩上，钟声告诉路上的人。
content.fx.the-gap-house.oc.greet-the-keeper.0.s: 门闩横在门上。贝特·阿什比早上会抬起它。
content.npc.bet.name: 贝特·阿什比
content.obj.the-gap-bell.ring-the-gap-bell.hint: 贝特·阿什比安在西墙的拉杆，在大厅半中间、牌子下方。
content.obj.the-gap-bell.ring-the-gap-bell.title: 敲响隘口钟
content.obj.the-gap-house.come-to-the-door.hint: 隘口屋的门，在门廊对面。
content.obj.the-gap-house.come-to-the-door.title: 走到门前
content.obj.the-gap-house.greet-the-keeper.hint: 贝特·阿什比在大厅远端，面朝门。
content.obj.the-gap-house.greet-the-keeper.title: 问候守屋人
content.quest.the-gap-bell.goal: 从大厅西墙的拉杆敲响隘口钟，让下面的人知道屋子夜里已经关门。
content.quest.the-gap-house.goal: 天黑前进入隘口屋，问候守屋人，她会在你身后闩上门。
content.world.outro: 隘口钟声传下山口，隘口屋今夜关门，一行人都在屋里。
content.world.title: 拉杆与守护者

source.class.traveller.blurb: You came up Harrow Gap with the last of the light, and the Gap House is the only roof between here and the far side.
source.class.traveller.kit.0.name: Walking stick
source.class.traveller.name: Traveller
source.dlg.bet.bet-bar.opt.0.label: One pull.
source.dlg.bet.bet-bar.text: There. Barred. Now the handle goes in the wall, under the sign, and you can ring her. One good pull.
source.dlg.bet.bet-dusk.opt.0.label: Then bar the door.
source.dlg.bet.bet-dusk.text: The gap bell, up on the roof. Its lever is on the west wall. I keep the handle in my apron, or every child who stops here rings it for fun.
source.dlg.bet.bet-hello.opt.0.label: Is there room for us?
source.dlg.bet.bet-hello.opt.1.label: What happens at dusk?
source.dlg.bet.bet-hello.text: In you come. You'll be the last up the Gap today, by the look of the sky.
source.dlg.bet.bet-ring.opt.0.label: One pull.
source.dlg.bet.bet-ring.text: The lever's in the wall under the sign. One good pull and she'll ring.
source.dlg.bet.bet-room.opt.0.label: What bell?
source.dlg.bet.bet-room.opt.1.label: Then bar it.
source.dlg.bet.bet-room.text: There's always room. The house is for whoever gets here by daylight. After that the door is barred and the bell tells the road.
source.fx.the-gap-bell.done.0.narrate: The house is shut for the night.
source.fx.the-gap-house.oc.greet-the-keeper.0.s: The bar is down across the door. Bet will lift it in the morning.
source.npc.bet.name: Bet Ashby
source.obj.the-gap-bell.ring-the-gap-bell.hint: The lever Bet set in the west wall, halfway down the hall, under the sign.
source.obj.the-gap-bell.ring-the-gap-bell.title: Ring the gap bell
source.obj.the-gap-house.come-to-the-door.hint: The Gap House door, across the porch.
source.obj.the-gap-house.come-to-the-door.title: Come to the door
source.obj.the-gap-house.greet-the-keeper.hint: Bet Ashby is at the far end of the hall, facing the door.
source.obj.the-gap-house.greet-the-keeper.title: Greet the keeper
source.quest.the-gap-bell.goal: Ring the gap bell from the lever on the hall's west wall, so the road below knows the house is shut for the night.
source.quest.the-gap-house.goal: Come in to the Gap House before dusk and greet its keeper, who bars the door behind you.
source.world.outro: The gap bell carries down the pass, and the Gap House is shut for the night with the party inside it.
source.world.title: The Lever and the Keeper
